qa_pairs.question: What is the URL for the Metrix portal specific to the Narval cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal URL for the Narval cluster is `https://portail.narval.calculquebec.ca`.

qa_pairs.question: In the context of the Metrix portal, what does "Narval" refer to?
qa_pairs.answer: "Narval" refers to one of the Alliance compute clusters, for which the Metrix portal provides real-time resource usage tracking.
